jurisdictions.name: Austria
jurisdictions.structure_note: One national regime: income tax, the 27.5% tax on capital income, the 30% tax on real estate gains and the real property acquisition tax are federal and the same in all nine states. There is no wealth, inheritance or gift tax. Only the municipal real estate tax (Grundsteuer) varies by municipality, and it is not counted. Klagenfurt am Wörthersee (capital of Carinthia) sets no rate of its own: it is not a separate region.

Dividends paid to non-resident individuals ("other recipients"): 27.5%, reduced by a treaty through refund or relief at source; 23% for corporations, 0% under the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive (PwC, last reviewed 4 Jul 2024).

treaties.note: No double taxation agreement. Austria is on the Mauritius Revenue Authority page only under tax information exchange agreements (TIEA) in force; it is absent from the treaties in force, awaiting ratification or signature, and under negotiation. Not on the Austrian Ministry of Finance treaty list either (dba-liste, updated 26 Jun 2026).

No double taxation agreement and no TIEA: Austria is not on the Seychelles Revenue Commission agreements page, nor is Seychelles on the Austrian Ministry of Finance treaty list (dba-liste, updated 26 Jun 2026).

gaps.detail: Austria is not in the UBS Global Wealth Report 2026 Millionaire Index table (p.21 lists 34 markets; Austria appears only in the wealth-per-adult rankings: mean 279,989, median 71,378 US$).
gaps.where_to_get: UBS Global Wealth Databook 2026 (the companion to the Global Wealth Report, https://www.ubs.com/global/en/wealthmanagement/insights/global-wealth-report.html), table of adults by wealth band, row Austria, column USD 1m+ → save in PDFs/ and tell Claude.

gaps.detail: Austrian law has no domestic trust; trusts and similar arrangements are registered in the beneficial-owners register (WiEReG, run by the Ministry of Finance), which publishes no count of them that we found. The private foundation (Privatstiftung) is a different legal form and is not counted as a trust.
gaps.where_to_get: Ask the Register Authority at the Austrian Ministry of Finance (WiEReG, https://www.bmf.gv.at/themen/finanzmarkt/wirtschaftliche-eigentuemer.html) for the number of trusts and trust-like arrangements registered; save the answer in PDFs/ and tell Claude.
